Name: Desert Chickens
Author: hiyajules98
Description:
[center][/center][left][b]NOTE:[/b] To unlock the desert chickens, you will need to visit the Desert Festival (Spring 15-17, once the Desert is unlocked) at least once. Then, Marnie will send a letter the following day (or immediately if you've already visited the festival in the past) saying she has the desert chickens available for purchase.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/n4XdwZb.png[/img][/left][size=5]
This mod adds:[/size]

[size=3]Pink Chickens
[/size][list]
[*]Purchase Price: 500
[*]Sell Price: 1000
[/list]
[size=3]Purple Chickens
[/size][list]
[*]Purchase Price: 500
[*]Sell Price: 1000
[/list]
[size=3]Pink Eggs
[/size][list]
[*]Regular Egg → Base Sell Price: 65
[*]Large Egg → Base Sell Price: 105
[/list]
[size=3]Purple Eggs
[/size][list]
[*]Regular Egg → Base Sell Price: 65
[*]Large Egg → Base Sell Price: 105
[/list]
[size=3]Pink Mayonnaise
[/size][list]
[*]Base Sell Price: 325
[/list]
[size=3]Purple Mayonnaise
[/size][list]
[*]Base Sell Price: 325
[/list]
[left][img]https://i.imgur.com/ad9prRZ.png[/img][/left]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿.
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.
[*]Extract into your [b]\Stardew Valley\Mods\[/b] folder.
[/list]
[left][img]https://i.imgur.com/qReNH1y.png[/img][/left][left][i]
If you would like compatibility with a specific mod, please reach out, and I will do my best to accommodate your request![/i]

[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20043]Elle's Cuter Coop Animals[/url]﻿ by junimods
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9057]Farm Animal Facelift[/url]﻿ by siamece
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21120]Cooler Chickens[/url]﻿ by PinkStations
[/list][/left]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/hxvaHeU.png[/img]

[list]
[*]﻿1.0.1 — Purple chickens can now be hatched by incubating a large purple egg; pink chickens can now be hatched by incubating a large pink egg (previously only regular eggs, not large eggs)
[*]1.0.0 — Mod uploaded with two chickens, four eggs, two mayonnaise, unlock condition, and machine interactions included.﻿
[/list]

Manifest.Name: (CP) Desert Chickens
Manifest.Description: Adds standalone pink and purple chickens as a purchasable farm animal, along with their eggs and mayonnaise. Based on the Speed Rooster from the Desert Festival.
Manifest.Author: hiyajules98
